title: Unique Umami Norwegian Cheese Casserole
description: A pungent and comforting Norwegian dish featuring green chilli and katsuramuki-cut cheese, perfect for a cold winter night. This ovo-vegetarian-friendly casserole is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with olive oil.
In a large skillet, saute the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the sliced green chilli to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the beaten eggs, sour cream, salt, black pepper, and smoked paprika.
Add the cooked onion and green chilli mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Arrange half of the katsuramuki-cut Gammelost cheese in the prepared baking dish.
Pour the egg mixture over the cheese in the baking dish.
Top the egg mixture with the remaining Gammelost cheese.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
